messages:
Maria (AcmeRetail): Hey team — since last night's model rollout our EU customers are seeing weird product descriptions: much more confident hallucinations (made-up SKUs). Happens only when requests route to eu-central pools, not US. Example: input and bad output attached. :frowning:

Jamie (Support): thanks Maria. Can you paste a minimal curl we can run to reproduce? Also which model id/version did you pin?

Maria (AcmeRetail): Sure — model: rwd-llama-3-13b:v2.3.1 (rolled 2026-03-14 22:10 UTC). Repro curl:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \u005c
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \u005c
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \u005c
  -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-3-13b:v2.3.1","input":"Write a short product blurb about 'Acme Widget 43' focusing on specs and compatibility.","max_tokens":120,"temperature":0.0}'
```
Response (bad):```json
{"output":"Acme Widget 43 — proprietary Acme part #AW-43X. Compatible with AcmeDock v3 and uses a custom 128-bit bus..."}```
The product and part numbers are fabricated. If I force requests through us-west we get normal outputs.

Jamie (Support): ok copying to SRE and ML. @Liam @Anya can you take a look? Marking high priority — customer is trialing a checkout flow. :warning:

Liam (SRE): looking. Can you share the request id + approximate request times? Also which EU cluster? Maria, you said eu-central — can you get the cluster id from response headers (x-redwood-cluster)?

Maria (AcmeRetail): header is x-redwood-cluster: eu-central-2a-a100-10g ; request id 01F3X7Z9. Time ~2026-03-15T01:12:10Z.

Ravi (Oncall): I pulled the logs for cluster eu-central-2a-a100-10g around that time. Not seeing infra OOMs or GPU ECCs. There is a model variant rollout event at 22:10 UTC that changed quantization profile to int8-quant-symmetric for that model.

Anya (ML): that's interesting — the change list for v2.3.1 included a new fused-ffn kernel and an updated quantization pass. We pushed canary to EU first. Do we have comparisons between outputs on A100 vs H100?

Liam (SRE): quick check: the EU pool in question is using A100 MIG partitions (10g) while some US pools are H100 full GPUs. So hardware differs.

Anya (ML): can we reproduce locally targeting an A100 with the same quant profile? I can run the eval harness with the same seed and prompt.

Jamie (Support): Maria — would you be willing to let us route a test request from our staging account to your tenant so we can iterate quickly? We can mask customer data.

Maria (AcmeRetail): yes please. I gave go-ahead in support ticket.

Anya (ML): repro steps I ran:```bash
# uses internal test client with model pinned to v2.3.1 and cluster hint header
python -m rwd.cli generate \
  --model rwd-llama-3-13b:v2.3.1 \
  --input "Write a short product blurb about 'Acme Widget 43' focusing on specs and compatibility." \
  --seed 42 \
  --max_tokens 120 \
  --headers '{"x-redwood-cluster":"eu-central-2a-a100-10g"}'
```
Result on eu-central A100 (bad): contains fabricated part numbers and confident hallucination.
Result on us-west H100 (good): factual, generic wording with no invented SKUs.

Anya (ML): I compared logits trace for a few tokens — on the A100 run the model produces a spike in token probabilities around tokens that form numeric identifiers. The fused-ffn kernel path has different range scaling with int8 path. Might be a quantization-kernel interaction.

Liam (SRE): I pulled the runtime config: kernel set = fused-ffn-v2-quant, quant_profile = int8-symmetric-v3. Rolling this to EU-only as canary matches your note.

Ravi (Oncall): mitigation options: 1) pin EU traffic to previous model v2.3.0; 2) roll back quant_profile to int16 on EU; 3) force routing of EU to H100 while we debug (costly). Which is lowest friction?

Jamie (Support): customer impact vs cost — suggest immediate pin to v2.3.0 for AcmeRetail only via per-tenant routing rule. That buys time while ML root-causes.

Maria (AcmeRetail): pinning is fine. We need confirmation when done.

Liam (SRE): performing tenant pin now. Command:```bash
redwood routing update --tenant acmeretail --model rwd-llama-3-13b:v2.3.0 --scope tenant --force-apply
```
Applying... done. Verified: subsequent requests to eu cluster for that tenant are served by v2.3.0.

Maria (AcmeRetail): confirmed — tests show expected non-hallucinated output now. Thank you. :pray:

Anya (ML): follow-up plan: I will run a battery of unit tests comparing v2.3.1 int8 on A100 vs H100 with controlled seeds. If we can reproduce deterministically we can bisect the kernel change and quantization pass. If deterministic, we file a kernel bug with the runtime team.

Dev Bot: Incident FYI — created ticket IN-2026-741: "Region-specific hallucination after quantized rollout (eu-central A100)" assigned to Anya + Liam.

Liam (SRE): also adding a temporary canary guard: block further canaries with int8-symmetric-v3 on A100 pools until ML signs off. Pushing policy change now.

Ravi (Oncall): monitoring: added a regression watchdog on production prompts set (customer-provided prompt set) — alert if KL divergence or hallucination markers exceed threshold in any cluster.

Jamie (Support): I'll keep the customer updated and mark ticket as "mitigated (tenant pinned)". We'll schedule a postmortem and coordinate a rollback vs fix timeline.

Maria (AcmeRetail): appreciate the quick response. Please keep me in loop for timeline — we may need a white-glove review before re-upgrade.

Anya (ML): will report back with initial bisect results within 8 hours. If we find the kernel bug, rollback to v2.3.0 will be recommended until a patched runtime/kernels release is validated.

Liam (SRE): noted. tagging this thread with #regression #eu #a100 #quantization for search.

Jamie (Support): thanks everyone. Closing the customer-facing loop now. Will update ticket with links to this thread and IN-2026-741. :thumbsup:
